d:
Here is a beautiful rendition of Musafir Hoon Yaron by Rishabh Tiwari featuring Sapna Rathore & Prashant Sethi. Music recreation and additional lyrics are by Tarun Sharma and the video is shot by Winston Jose.
The original music was composed by R.D.Burman, penned by Gulzar, and sung by Kishore Kumar for the film Parichay.
Credits:
Song: Musafir Hoon Yaron
Singer: Rishabh Tiwari
Music recreated by: Tarun Sharma
Additional Lyrics: Tarun Sharma
Arranged mixed and mastered by: Tarun Sharma
